zh.title: 全球异象
zh.content:
今天，中国正在以前所未有的姿态全面影响着整个世界——无论是在经济巨浪、科技创新还是文化输出的各个领域，全球都无法忽视这股力量。然而，在属灵与宗教的版图上，世界往往只能看到一片迷雾。你或许常常听到外界的论调，认为这里是一片无神论的荒漠，或者只能看到福音事工在这里所面对的重重限制、围墙与极大的不易。是的，在这片土地上开展福音工作绝非易事。但纵观圣经救赎史，当神的子民在旷野中面对最严苛的逼迫与试炼时，往往正是万军之耶和华要在危机中掀起历史性大复兴的开端！

“出埃及记 1:12 —— 只是越发苦害他们，他们越发多起来，越发蔓延开来。”


在这里有无数在大逼迫中淬炼出大信心的基督徒；在这里，有无数家庭教会已经传承了超过三代人，他们的信仰不是温室里的花朵，而是从烈火中走出来的精金。在这场波澜壮阔的现代复兴运动中，中国的基督徒正在圣灵的膏沐中站立起来——我们不仅在这片土地上守望服侍，更被差遣走向列国列邦，在全地所有的领域中深扎、渗透，预备将天国的荣耀带下！

国度策略：我们的宣教不仅发生在教堂的围墙之内，更发生在时代的各行各业之中。面对新一代的年轻人，我们核心的国度策略是：在职场与商业的第一线，建立完全属于天国的文化与生命样式。

马太福音 5:14-16 —— 你们是世上的光。城造在山上是不能隐藏的……你们的光也当这样照在人前，叫他们看见你们的好行为，便将荣耀归给你们在天上的父。

在职场中，我们通过卓越的专业能力、公义的商业诚实、以及活泼的见证故事，成为世界的光与盐。我们要进入文化的上游，在科技、创意、和产业的赛道上开疆拓土，用天国的价值观去夺回、去影响、去塑造正在迷失的新一代年轻人，让职场成为宣教的第一宣教工场。

行动：代祷合一、职场同工与财务互助

祭坛上的合一： 我们要在教会与团契的深层代祷中保持高度合一，打破地域的局限，不断在祭坛前寻求神对于跨国宣教与技术赋能的最新时代带领。

“传道书 4:12 —— 有人攻胜孤身一人，若有二人便能敌挡他；三股合成的绳子不容易折断。”

财务上的互助： 我们要建立坚固的国度供求与奉献网络，在财务、物资和供应链资源上，去全力支持、安慰、帮助那些在患难、逼迫和缺乏中的弟兄姊妹。用实实在在的国度相爱，见证那不可震动的国。

“约翰一书 3:18 —— 小子们哪，我们相爱，不要只在言语和舌头上，总要在行为和诚实上。”

en.title: Global Vision
en.content:
Today, China is impacting the entire world with unprecedented momentum—whether through massive economic waves, technological innovation, or cultural exports, the global community cannot ignore this force. Yet, on the spiritual and religious map, the world often sees only a dense mist. You may frequently hear outside narratives describing this place as an atheistic wasteland, or focusing solely on the heavy restrictions, walls, and extreme difficulties faced by gospel ministries here.Yes, carrying out gospel work in this land is by no means easy. But throughout biblical redemptive history, whenever God's people faced the harshest persecution and trials in the wilderness, it was always the exact moment the Lord of Hosts was about to spark a historic, great revival amidst the crisis!

"But the more they were oppressed, the more they multiplied and the more they spread abroad." — Exodus 1:12

Here, there are countless Christians whose profound faith has been refined through intense persecution; here, numerous house churches have passed down their ministry through more than three generations. Their faith is not a hothouse flower, but pure gold emerged from the fiery furnace. In this magnificent modern revival movement, Chinese Christians are standing up under the anointing of the Holy Spirit—we are not only watching and serving in this land, but are also being sent forth to nations and tribes, deep-rooting and permeating every sphere of society to bring down the glory of the Kingdom of God!

Kingdom Strategy：
Our mission does not just happen within the walls of a church building; it unfolds across all walks of life in this generation. As we face the new generation of youth, our core Kingdom strategy is: to establish a culture and lifestyle that belongs entirely to the Kingdom of God on the frontlines of the marketplace and business.
"You are the light of the world. A city set on a hill cannot be hidden... In the same way, let your light shine before others, so that they may see your good works and give glory to your Father who is in heaven." — Matthew 5:14-16

In the marketplace, we become the salt and light of the world through excellent professional competence, righteous business integrity, and living testimony stories. We must enter the upstream of culture, pioneering and expanding in the arenas of technology, creativity, and industry. We aim to use Kingdom values to reclaim, influence, and shape the lost youth of this new generation, turning the marketplace into the primary mission field.

Actions: Unity in Prayer, Marketplace Co-laboring, and Financial Mutual Aid
Unity at the Altar: We must maintain a deep level of unity in our intercessory prayers within the church and fellowships, breaking through geographical limitations. We continuously seek God's latest timely guidance for cross-border missions and technological enablement before the altar.
"And though a man might prevail against one who is alone, two will withstand him—a threefold cord is not quickly broken." — Ecclesiastes 4:12

Financial Mutual Aid: We will build a solid Kingdom supply-and-demand and tithing network. Through financial, material, and supply chain resources, we will fully support, comfort, and aid our brothers and sisters who are going through trials, persecution, and lack. Through tangible Kingdom love, we witness to a Kingdom that cannot be shaken.
"Little children, let us not love in word or talk but in deed and in truth." — 1 John 3:18
